# Apache ECharts 6.0.0

Pinned upstream ES module distribution, used by the map lab's benchmark charts only.
Loaded locally when a completed report is displayed; no runtime CDN or build step.

- Source: https://github.com/apache/echarts/tree/6.0.0
- Distribution: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apache/echarts/6.0.0/dist/echarts.esm.min.js
- Stacked bars: https://echarts.apache.org/handbook/en/how-to/chart-types/bar/stacked-bar/
- Interactive legends: https://echarts.apache.org/handbook/en/concepts/legend/
- Upstream licensing and notices are preserved in `LICENSE`, `NOTICE` and `licenses/LICENSE-d3`.
